source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
log = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
unreleased = log.split("## [1.4.1]", 1)[0]
assert "## [Unreleased]" in unreleased
assert "retornatus init --preset" in unreleased
assert "docs/assets/retornatus-mascot-readme.webp" in unreleased
assert "The README mascot looks the same on GitHub dark and light themes." in unreleased
assert "retornatus-mascot.webp" not in unreleased
print("changelog keeps both entries")'
